name: web-analytics-dashboard
title: Web Analytics Dashboard
description: A responsive dashboard grid with a twelve-month visitor area chart, a live visitor count split by device, ranked tables for pages, countries and referrers, share bars, and Core Web Vitals.
use: A product or marketing site needs a ready-made overview of traffic, sources and page performance.
avoid: Live or real data, since every figure and table row is sample data baked into the file.
a11y: Tables carry screen-reader captions and the chart is keyboard reachable, but the pulsing live dot ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Laid out as a four column grid of bordered cards: a wide area chart with a large total, a live visitors card with three device share bars, then tables for top pages, countries and referrers, small share-bar cards, and a three-up Core Web Vitals row.
behaves: Mostly static: hovering chart points raises a tooltip, the live visitor dot pulses continuously, and View All links sit over faded table edges. Figures never update on their own.
customise: Every figure, table row and chart point is a constant in the file, so real data means editing or lifting the subcomponents. Colours follow the chart theme variables.
weight: moderate: A Recharts area chart plus several tables; mostly static markup with one pulsing dot.
